findings.evidence: Line 4 contains raw control bytes in the artifact paths: CR before `eview.json`, TAB before `est.json`, and BEL before `rtifacts/schemas/`.
findings.impact: The generated iteration instructions render as damaged paths, so the expected review/test artifact filenames and schema directory are unclear to collaborators.
